label: Elevated Distress Profile
summary: A female respondent with graduate-level education and more than five hours of daily screen time who reports higher-than-average loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours of daily screen time.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 (mean 1.69).
Reports higher depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9 (mean 1.75).
Reports higher anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7 (mean 2.16).
Spends more than five hours per day on screens.
tone: Cautious, clinically neutral, and evidence-grounded; avoid diagnostic language and emphasize that these are group-level tendencies rather than individual certainties.

label: Low-Distress Graduate Male
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, showing low loneliness and very low depressive and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Male; graduate degree or above; 1–3 hours of activity per day.
behavior_markers: Maintains a moderate daily activity window of 1–3 hours.
